correctness.rationale:
Writing a source integer as \(m=2^k u\) with \(u\) odd separates the valuation and odd part of \(e(m)=2^k u(k+2)\). Setting \(t=
u_2(k+2)\) forces \(k=\ell-t\) for a target \(n=2^\ell w\), which yields the stated necessary-and-sufficient valuation and divisibility conditions and a unique preimage for each admissible \(t\). The unboundedness construction is proved by the recurrence \(a_{j+1}=a_j+2^{a_j}\): later increments are divisible by one extra power of two, so \(
u_2(a_{R+1}-a_j)=a_j\). A packaged exhaustive replay agrees with the exact formula for every target through 400000 and checks the first three constructed branching levels.

value.rationale: The source paper makes this exponent map a central proof device and explicitly flags its noninjectivity. An exact fiber formula is a natural structural completion of that observation, while unbounded finite indegree is a substantive boundary for attempts to extend orbit telescoping beyond carefully separated seeds: no global bounded-merger simplification is available. The result is not an arbitrary small computation or parameter slice; it is an infinite classification with an explicit family witnessing unbounded branching.
